column1: # Broken-oracle ledger — pinned-PeTTa-malformed tests, adjudicated with evidence.
# A file listed here is one where the PINNED PeTTa oracle itself errors or
# asserts-out on a malformed test, AND PLeaTTa's independent result (recorded in
# every coverage row as pleatta_independent) shows PLeaTTa is not the defect.
# Each file has a corrected same-capability witness in oracle-witnesses/ that
# both engines AGREE on; membership therefore yields ORACLE-WITNESS-COVERED
# (capability demonstrated) while the original malformed test stays adjudicated.
# It is never inferred from a bare PETTA-ERROR: each entry is justified by the
# captured both-engines evidence in the reason column.
